pqac-6dc29431: The paper is **“A systematic review on sustainability assessment of internal combustion engines”** by **Haoye Liu, Shiwu Yu, Tianyou Wang, Ji Li, and Yuanjing Wang** . The abstract states that the authors identified **87 life cycle assessment studies** published between **2017 and 2023** from the **Scopus database**. Their search used the keywords **“Sustainability assessment” OR “Life cycle assessment” AND “Internal combustion engine*” OR “ICE*”**, followed by careful screening. The studies were then classified and analyzed by **six aspects**: sustainability indicators, life cycle phases, life cycle inventories, ICE technologies (including alternative fuels), types of mobile sources, and powertrain systems.
From Haoye Liu, Shiwu Yu, Tianyou Wang, Ji Li, and Yuanjing Wang. A systematic review on sustainability assessment of internal combustion engines. Journal of Cleaner Production, 2024. URL: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jclepro.2024.141996, doi:10.1016/j.jclepro.2024.141996.

pqac-bffb6184: The excerpt identifies a 2022 paper by Jeroen B. Guinée, Arjan de Koning, and Reinout Heijungs titled “Life cycle assessment-based Absolute Environmental Sustainability Assessment is also relative” in the Journal of Industrial Ecology. The abstract says that a recent review of LCA-based AESA methods and applications characterized 47 studies according to intended application, impact categories, basis of carrying capacity estimates, spatial differentiation of the environmental model, and principles for assigning carrying capacity. It also notes that the review and most studies did not adequately discuss temporal issues. However, the excerpt does not mention a review of 87 studies, nor does it provide screening criteria or classification rules for such a review.
From Jeroen B. Guinée, Arjan de Koning, and Reinout Heijungs. Life cycle assessment‐based absolute environmental sustainability assessment is also relative. Journal of Industrial Ecology, 2022. URL: https://doi.org/10.1111/jiec.13260, doi:10.1111/jiec.13260.
